common_evaluation.function: Abstract-level symptom signal (fatigue onset and tender joints) retained; no verified objective strength or physical-performance result from the unavailable main. Symptoms cannot inherit strength credit.
common_evaluation.exposure: Human administered MAX-EPA mixture dose identified, with form, assay, placebo composition and outcome denominators unresolved; no pediatric/MVA exposure established.
common_evaluation.durability: 14-week periods with reported persistence beyond 4 weeks; this is a carryover warning and a limited persistence observation, not quantified durable muscle benefit after cessation.
common_evaluation.renewal: No stem/progenitor renewal or regeneration evidence established by the inspected source scope.
common_evaluation.fidelity: No BUBR1 restoration, spindle-checkpoint, chromosome-segregation or aneuploidy correction established by the inspected source scope.
common_evaluation.bub1b_mva: No BUB1B-MVA response or variant-specific efficacy established; no superiority to provisional niacin restoration or apitegromab compensation established.
